sourceRefs.locator: Opening and attendance paragraphs: 10 July 511 conclusion, the king’s summons, thirty-two bishops and their seven provinces.
pp. 161–163, especially p. 163 and n. 60. Cyprian of Bordeaux and five further bishops attended both Agde in 506 and Orléans in 511; canon 5 and prisoners.

labels.de: Die Bischöfe des Ersten Konzils von Orléans
labels.en: Bishops of the First Council of Orléans

summary.de: 32 Bischöfe aus sieben gallischen Provinzen. Unter ihnen finden sich sechs Teilnehmer der Versammlung von Agde.
summary.en: Thirty-two bishops from seven Gallic provinces, including six who had attended the council at Agde.
